analyst.summary: Cupid Ltd makes male and female condoms, lubricants and diagnostic kits, and has become one of the fastest-growing names in its space -- revenue and profit have roughly doubled year-on-year for several quarters running, backed by real capacity expansion, a new premium female-condom product line, a long-term supply deal with a major global health-procurement agency, and a first overseas manufacturing plant planned in Saudi Arabia. The business itself looks genuinely stronger than a year ago. But the share price has moved even faster than the business -- up roughly 8-11x over one to two years -- and now trades at an extremely rich valuation (over 260 times trailing earnings, around 70 times book value) that leaves very little room for anything to go wrong in what remains a government/institutional tender-driven revenue base. We rate it a Hold, but are flagging the valuation extremity for portfolio-manager review rather than treating it as a routine call.
